Decode gh output as UTF-8 in the control plane: run_json/capture_live_state in scripts/score2gp_orca_control.py use the locale codec and crash with cp1252 UnicodeDecodeError on Windows
backlog.notes: Observed on reviewer runs and again 2026-09-26: `score2gp_orca_control.py snapshot --pull-request 700` failed with UnicodeDecodeError (byte 0x9d) because subprocess.run(text=True) has no encoding. Pass encoding='utf-8' to every gh subprocess in the control plane (run_json; the gh calls in score2gp_got_bootstrap.py), with a test that feeds non-cp1252 UTF-8 bytes and a negative control. Workaround until fixed: PYTHONUTF8=1.
